units.source_text: 源氏公子见葵姬分娩，大小平安，心中稍稍安宁。

en.t: Prince Genji saw that Lady Aoi had given birth and that mother and child were both safe, and his heart grew a little calmer.

units.source_text: 但想起那活人魂灵不问自招的怪事，甚是懊恼。

en.t: But when he thought of the strange affair in which that living spirit had confessed without being questioned, he felt deeply troubled.

units.source_text: 他久不访问六条妃子，觉得对她不起。

en.t: He had not visited the Lady of Rokujo for a long time, and felt that he had wronged her.

units.source_text: 但念倘使和她见了面，有何话可说呢？

en.t: Yet he wondered what he could possibly say if he were to meet her face to face.
The meeting would surely leave both hearts uneasy.

units.source_text: 为她着想，也使她反而为难。

en.t: Even if he meant to consider her feelings, he would only end up making things harder for her.

units.source_text: 左思右想，终于不去探访，但写了一封信去。

en.t: After thinking it over from every side, he finally decided not to visit her, but instead wrote and sent her a letter.
